framework: Django 5.2 templates + htmx 2 (server-rendered HTML, no bundler)

font_stack.now: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next + Mono, self-hosted in static/boards/fonts (OFL-1.1)

motion: no motion library; CSS only, request indicators are the only movement
constraints: Content-Security-Policy default-src 'self': no inline style or script, no external origins
Every htmx request needs hx-indicator and hx-disabled-elt (CLAUDE.md, test_status_indicator.py)
The server answers HTML only; every action swaps the whole #board block
